test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who is easily deceived
solution:
The correct answer is 'Gullible'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• Credible - able to be believed; convincing.
 
• Gullible - easily persuaded to believe something; credulous.
 
• Inedible - not fit or suitable for eating.
 
• Inaudible - unable to be heard.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that gullible is the correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
